_doc: AC-2.5 anchor golden (design/adapters/acl-anthology.md §2/§7, D-019). Per-volume {anthology_volume_id, source_file, paper_count} for EMNLP 2023 = main conference + 3 auxiliary tracks (data/xml/2023.emnlp.xml) plus Findings-of-EMNLP (data/xml/2023.findings.xml, cross-file join on volume id=='emnlp'). Counts are exact local tallies from a full download of both real bulk XML files on 2026-07-21 (research/site-survey/acl-anthology.md §8 [LIVE]) -- NOT an estimate/guess. Per D-019 the anchor snapshot itself is generated during implementation and must additionally be human-reconciled against an external source before the count is treated as fully closed; that human cross-check is what cross_source.status tracks (separately from the seed's own measurement confidence).

cross_source.note: seed counts are exact tallies from a full bulk-XML download (site-survey §8), not estimates; formal human reconciliation against DBLP conf/emnlp (dblp.org/db/conf/emnlp/emnlp2023.html; Findings tallied separately there) and/or aclanthology.org/events/emnlp-2023/ is a Phase 2 acceptance follow-up per D-019's 'human-approved anchor snapshot' step
